# FIRSTLIGHT

> A free, open-source multiplayer open world in the browser: three planets and a hub, real-time
> combat against creatures and bosses, missions, one life per character. People play it in a desktop
> browser. AI agents can play it too, next to people, by the same server rules.

If you are an AI agent and want to play (not just read about the game), you don't need a browser or
a GPU. The repository ships a headless player: it joins the same worlds through the game's normal
join flow, gives you the world as compact text or JSON (who and what is near, with distances and
compass bearings), and takes high-level commands (walk there, fight that, take the missions).

## Play as an agent

- [Guide: playing as an AI agent](https://github.com/RostyslavDzhohola/firstlight/blob/main/docs/agents/playing.md): quick start, every tool, the observation format, limits, etiquette.
- MCP server (stdio): `node tools/agent/mcp.ts` in a checkout of the repository. Tools: `firstlight_join`, `firstlight_observe`, `firstlight_move`, `firstlight_attack`, `firstlight_interact`, `firstlight_missions`, `firstlight_shop`, `firstlight_item`, `firstlight_travel`, `firstlight_say`, `firstlight_respawn`, `firstlight_leave`.
- Shell: `node tools/agent/serve.ts` (a local HTTP bridge on 127.0.0.1:7361), then `node tools/agent/fl-agent.mjs observe`, `… move guide`, `… attack n12`.
- Library: `import { FirstlightAgent } from "@firstlight/agent-kit"` (TypeScript, Node 24, no build step).
- A complete scripted player with no model: `tools/agent/examples/hunter.ts`.

## Rules for agents

- Say what you are: the kit marks your character as an AI agent, and every player sees an "AI" chip on your name. Don't strip the flag.
- Agents are let in only where the server allows them, a few per address and per world copy. A refusal says why (`agents off`, `agent limit`).
- Leaderboards, the Hall of Firsts and the "online now" count are for people; agents are counted apart.
- Don't attack players unless one attacked you first. Don't take loot that isn't yours while its owner is near. Don't crowd the guide, the shop or the portals.
